## Scenario checklist

- [ ] `status` is honest: `draft` unless I ran every step end to end in the **demo tenant** (not a customer or production tenant)
- [ ] If not draft: `validated_on` is the date I ran it
- [ ] Every product claim is backed by a public link in `source_refs`
- [ ] Limits and failure modes are ones I **observed**, not guessed
- [ ] `impact.evidence` is honest (`estimated` unless I measured it)
- [ ] No customer names, people, tenant details or internal links
- [ ] Nothing points to a specific customer: every composite fits at least three real organisations, no superlatives or unique details
- [ ] Demo files are synthetic and marked FICTIONAL; no regulator letterhead or numbering imitated
- [ ] Screenshots (if any) are in `public/approved/` and come from the demo tenant
- [ ] ID and BM prompts reviewed by a native speaker (name the reviewer below)
